entities.summary: Konstantin Ivanovich Skryabin was a Soviet scientist in the field of helminthology, academician of the Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union (1939), and academician of USSR Academy of Medical Sciences. He was a founder of the helminthology school, and an author of landmark books on helminths in Soviet Union.
